title: Michael Kratsios ethics completion and recusal ledger — bounded records result
summary: The nominee record establishes divestment and recusal commitments, but the actual signed ethics agreement, compliance certification, completion dates, recusals and waivers were not recovered from indexed public pages; the target remains blocked on public-document acquisition rather than being treated as evidence of non-compliance.

data.question: Did Michael Kratsios complete the divestments and recusals promised in his 2025 ethics agreement, on what dates, and were any waivers, authorizations or extensions issued?
data.method: Reconcile the Senate nominee record with OGE's public-document rules and current public disclosure/transaction surfaces; search indexed OGE, OSTP, White House and DocumentCloud surfaces for the post-confirmation ethics documents.
data.framework: Separate commitment, deadline, completion evidence, recusal evidence and waiver evidence. Missing records are not evidence of non-compliance.
findings: The Senate questionnaire says Kratsios would divest Scale AI equity/options, bitcoin and ethereum if confirmed and follow recusal obligations in his ethics agreement.
The Senate confirmed Kratsios on March 25, 2025.

OGE says PAS appointees ordinarily complete ethics-agreement actions and file a Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance within 90 days of confirmation unless the agreement or an extension provides otherwise; the ordinary 90-day point here was June 23, 2025.

OGE's public collection includes ethics agreements, compliance certifications, certificates of divestiture and other ethics records, and its Online Form 201 guidance says ethics agreements and compliance certifications can be immediately downloaded after selecting the official.

The current ProPublica disclosure interface displays the pre-service Scale AI equity/options and crypto holdings and later 2025-2026 public-market transactions but no visible Scale AI, bitcoin or ethereum disposition in the displayed transaction table.

The visible absence of those transactions does not establish that divestment failed; the compliance certification, private-company disposition records, amendments or other documents may supply the missing evidence.

A bounded indexed-web search did not recover the actual Kratsios ethics agreement, Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance, certificate of divestiture, extension/modification, recusal memorandum, authorization or waiver.

The Senate questionnaire says Scale AI employment ended January 17, 2024; ProPublica's parsed employment-agreement text displays an inconsistent January 17, 2021 value while the same page separately lists Scale Managing Director service through January 2025. The discrepancy is preserved rather than silently reconciled.
conclusions: The public indexed record supports the existence of divestment and recusal commitments but does not yet support a dated completion ledger.
The target should be blocked on acquisition of the public OGE/OSTP ethics documents, not marked completed and not converted into an allegation of non-compliance.
recommendations: Obtain the signed ethics agreement, compliance certification, any amendments/extensions, certificates of divestiture and any public waivers/recusal memoranda through OGE/OSTP's authorized public-record access path.
On acquisition, reopen the logical target and build a commitment-to-completion chronology.
counterarguments: An absent transaction in an aggregator is not proof that a required disposition did not occur.
Continuing participation in former-employer retirement accounts without employer contributions is not continuing employment.
Past work for Thiel Capital or Scale AI does not establish current direction of government policy.
limitations: The OGE individual-disclosures collection is interactive and the available research tooling could not complete the selection/request flow without requester information.
Indexed web search is not a complete substitute for OGE's official document collection.
unresolved: bitcoin and ethereum divestment completion dates
18 U.S.C. § 208 waiver or other authorization, if any

workflow.next_action: Acquire the actual public ethics agreement/compliance/waiver records through OGE or OSTP, then reopen.
